text.style: font-size: 14.21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: parameters, magnitude beats normalised — so the C=4096 result is not an artefact of a starved pilot. Base CE differs from the 8k-pilot figure
